query: Whaat Wash LLC, Cape Coral, FL
name: Whaat Wash LLC
hours: Wednesday (Veterans Day), Open 24 hours, Hours might differ

reviewSamples.author: Brooke Murdock
reviewSamples.text: I found Josh thru the Nextdoor app and what a find! I couldn't be happier with his work. He pressure washed and sealed our driveway, walkway and front entry, pressure cleaned the house, lanai cage and floor and even painted the lanai floor. …

reviewSamples.author: Susan Kohler
reviewSamples.text: Josh worked very hard and did a great job. My pool deck and porch pavers and house look so clean and beautiful!  I will call on him again for sure. 👍😊 …

reviewSamples.author: Emily Hewitt
reviewSamples.text: Wow what a night and day difference! Our lanai and driveway was pressure washed and painted beautifully! He was able to apply the grit + paint onto the pool deck so it’s no longer slippery! Very satisfied.

reviewSamples.author: Erin A
reviewSamples.text: I was blown away at how good the house looked after it had been cleaned.  I thought it would look better but if I didn’t know better, I would have thought I had new gutters, soffits, garage door, etc.  The driveway itself looks phenomenal.    I wish I had a “before” picture but this wall was green with algae.   It’s perfect now!

reviewSamples.author: FRANCISCO MERCED
reviewSamples.text: My driveway was just a mess dirty and dark, Whaat Wash did a real good job, I'm very satisfied with the quality and price.
